changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbodymeasurements AS SELECT bm.id, bm.patient_id, bm.encounter_id, bm.weight, bm.height, bm.head_circumference, bm.is_active, bm.created_by, bm.created_date, bm.last_modified_by, bm.last_modified_date FROM public.body_measurements bm;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbodymeasurements TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbodymeasurements FROM report_user;
